How many triangles does the mural show? A. $49$ B. $50$ C. $59$ D. $60$
17: An isosceles triangle is given, in which a leg of length 20 makes an angle of 67.5° with the base. The area of this triangle equals: A. 100sqrt3 B. 100sqrt2 C. 200sqrt3 D. 200sqrt2
18: The figures below show the nets of two pyramids. How many times is the volume of the pyramid with edge $a$ greater than the volume of the pyramid with edge $b$? A. $\sqrt2$ B. $2$ C. $2\sqrt2$ D. $4$

22: The sequence (a_n) is defined by the formula a_n = (24-4n)/n for n>=1. The number of all nonnegative integer terms of this sequence equals: A. 7 B. 6 C. 5 D. 4

27: The half-life of an element is the time needed for 50% of it to remain from 100%. This means the amount remaining from each gram of the element after x half-life periods is given by the formula y=(1/2)^x. For the isotope iodine-131, the half-life is 8 days. Determine the smallest number of days after which no more than 0.125 g of this element remains from 1 g of 131-I.
29: The value of the average speed is calculated as the ratio of distance to the time in which that distance was covered. A car traveled from town A to town C through town B, which is halfway between A and C. The average speed of the car on the route from A to B was 40 km/h, and from B to C - 60 km/h. Calculate the average speed of the car on the entire route from A to C.
30: 16 theater tickets were purchased, including 10 tickets for seats 1 through 10 in the first row and 6 tickets for seats 11 through 16 in the sixteenth row. What is the probability of the event that 2 tickets drawn, out of the sixteen, will be tickets for adjacent seats?
32: Points $A=(3,3)$ and $B=(9,1)$ are vertices of triangle $ABC$, and point $M=(1,6)$ is the midpoint of side $AC$. Calculate the coordinates of the intersection point of line $AB$ with the altitude of this triangle drawn from vertex $C$.
33: The slant height of a cone is 17, and the height of the cone is shorter than the diameter of its base by 22. Calculate the total surface area and the volume of this cone.
